newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-CELTICS' FOX EXERCISES OPTION TO BECOME FREE AGENT.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-CELTICS' FOX EXERCISES OPTION TO BECOME FREE AGENT.

text.p: Boston Celtics starting forward and team captain Rick Fox, who averaged a career-best 15.5 points per game this season, exercised an option in his contract on Thursday to become a free agent.
Fox also averaged 5.2 rebounds and 3.8 assists over 76 games for Boston, which struggled to a franchise-worst 15-67 record this season.
The 27-year-old Fox ranked sixth in the NBA with 2.2 steals per game and his total of 167 thefts set a Celtics season record, previously held by Larry Bird.
Fox was Boston's first-round pick (24th overall) in 1991 out of North Carolina.
